_readme: Optional hand-written write-ups. Anything you put here REPLACES the text the
dashboard derives from the Excel columns, and is badged 'written up' on screen.
Leave 'projects' empty and everything stays derived from the tracker.
Key each entry by the tracker ID (the number in the All sheet's ID column, without
the .0) or by the exact task name. Every field is optional - fill only what you want
"what": "One paragraph on what the project actually is.",
"how": "How it was built - stack, data sources, decisions made.",
"why": "Why it existed and what changed because of it.",
"why": "Only overriding the why; what and how stay derived from Excel."
The dashboard warns you if a key here matches no project, so typos are caught.
